GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.7 (23 Dec 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 487)
APO 500
23 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Sale of "Fog Oil" to Japanese Government.
1. At a conference held 19 October 1945, at which there were present Mr. M. Yoshida and Mr. T. Suzuki of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Fuel Bureau, and Mr. ▲. Ushiki of Petroleum Distribution Control Company, this Headquarters agreed to sell to and the Japanese Government agreed to purchase and accept delivery F. O. B. ships sling at Yokohama of two cargoes, approximately 74,100 drums of Fog Oil at a tentative price of U. S. O. $0.39 per United States gallon, drums included.
2. Quantitative receipts are held by this Headquarters for delivery as follows:
Ex. S. S. Sturdy Beggar
38,591 drums, 53 United States gallons each,
EX. S. S. Cape Meredith
32, 388 drums, 53 United States gallons each, a total of 3,761,887 United States gallons.
3. Adjusted price is $ 0.31 per United States gallon.
4. Value of obligation is U. S. O. $1,166,184.97.
5. This Headquarters will advise you method of meeting this obligation at a later date.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
